decisions.reason: Construction site dumpers build directly on the firm's existing construction and material-handling vehicle knowledge, so it can assimilate early results and improve the product.
Inclined furniture lifts draw on the firm's lifting and safety engineering, though the furniture application is somewhat adjacent, giving it enough related knowledge to learn and keep the line.
Inclined building material lifts are closely tied to the firm's construction and lifting expertise, making it likely that management can interpret and act on early results.
Truck-mounted inclined furniture lifts combine the firm's vehicle and lifting capabilities, so absorptive capacity supports learning and retention despite the narrower furniture segment.
